title.quote: Video Killed the HD-Map: Predicting Multi-Agent Behavior Directly From Aerial Images
title.justification: This is the paper title shown at the beginning of the manuscript.
title.value: Video Killed the HD-Map: Predicting Multi-Agent Behavior Directly From Aerial Images

extractions.description: An empirical computer-vision and autonomous-driving study that trains and evaluates ITRA trajectory-prediction variants using aerial image-based maps instead of rasterized HD maps, including vehicle, pedestrian, image-quality, traffic-light, and Bing-imagery evaluations.

type.quote: We evaluate multi-agent trajectory prediction using the AIM by incorporating it into a differentiable driving simulator as an image-texture-based differentiable rendering module.
type.justification: The paper trains models and reports quantitative validation experiments and ablations.

name.justification: The paper explicitly identifies this as the prediction problem it studies.

name.quote: in the field of autonomous driving
name.justification: The proposed representation and simulator experiments address learned traffic behavior for autonomous-driving simulation.
The paper is categorized in computer vision and uses aerial imagery and image encoders as core inputs.

name.quote: Creating realistic simulation environments is crucial for evaluating self-driving vehicles
name.justification: The work advances learned, differentiable traffic simulation through a new map representation and renderer.
Pedestrian motion prediction is a separately trained and evaluated application domain in the experiments.
